label: Koh Chang
short_description: Thailand's third-largest island, near Cambodia, with a national park interior and quieter beaches.
intro: Koh Chang's hotels in this directory sit on an island in Trat province near the Cambodian border, about 300 km southeast of Bangkok, most of it protected as Mu Ko Chang National Park. It draws a more laid-back crowd than Phuket or Ko Samui, with resorts spread thinly along west-coast beaches from White Sand Beach down to quieter Lonely Beach and Bailan, and getting around still generally requires a car, taxi, or resort transfer rather than walking between properties.
